comment: The class of each tool of hyper (S1), found by the layout of the repository (K286): ecosystem names the tool it uses, policy the reason no ecosystem tool applies.

benchmarks/browser.mts.tool: Playwright drives Chromium and measures the board example; node:perf_hooks times the steps

benchmarks/server.php.tool: hrtime(true) of PHP times App::handle and the template program on the board example

benchmarks/sessions.mts.tool: node:child_process runs the session workers and the CPU of INFO of Redis counts the cost; node:perf_hooks times them

benchmarks/uploads-native.php.tool: getrusage of PHP reports the processor time and the largest memory of the worker that read a body into $_POST and $_FILES

benchmarks/uploads.mts.tool: node:http and node:net send the bodies to one real server of each implementation, PHP-FPM over FastCGI; node:perf_hooks times the requests and getrusage of each server reports its use

examples/board/app/handlers.php.reason: the handlers of the board example, an application of the PHP server; it implements no tool of an ecosystem

examples/board/client/main.ts.tool: htmx.org and @polyspec/hyper-client run the page of the board example in the browser

examples/board/node/handlers.ts.reason: the handlers of the board example, an application of the Node server; it implements no tool of an ecosystem

examples/board/node/main.ts.tool: node:http through App.server of @polyspec/hyper serves the board example

examples/board/node/posts.ts.tool: node:sqlite stores the posts of the board example

examples/board/public/assets/after-reade.reason: the second module script of the post page of the board example, which records its run after reader.js (HYC-25); it implements no tool of an ecosystem

examples/board/public/assets/reader.js.reason: the first module script of the post page of the board example, which records its run so that the browser tests see the order of the module scripts (HYC-25); it implements no tool of an ecosystem

examples/board/public/index.php.tool: the front controller of the PHP SAPI (the built-in server or php-fpm) calls App::run of polyspec/hyper

examples/board/python/handlers.py.reason: the handlers of the board example, an application of the Python server; it implements no tool of an ecosystem

examples/board/python/main.py.tool: the standard library http.server through create_server of polyspec.hyper serves the board example

examples/board/python/posts.py.tool: sqlite3 of the standard library stores the posts of the board example

examples/board/src/Board/Assets.php.reason: reads the manifest.json that hyper-build-assets writes (HR-34) for the layout of the board example; no ecosystem tool names the assets of this build

examples/board/src/Board/Posts.php.tool: PDO with the SQLite driver stores the posts of the board example

packages/cli/bin/hyper-build-assets.mjs.tool: esbuild bundles the client, @tailwindcss/node and @tailwindcss/oxide build the stylesheet, and @polyspec/template parses the templates

packages/cli/bin/hyper-build-server.mjs.tool: @polyspec/template-compiler compiles the templates into the PHP program and the type manifest

packages/cli/bin/hyper.mjs.tool: parseArgs of node:util reads the arguments of the subcommands build and check, and the exit code reports the result (HR-96)

packages/cli/lib/build.mjs.tool: esbuild bundles the client, @tailwindcss/node and @tailwindcss/oxide build the stylesheets, and node:crypto hashes the outputs for the build id

packages/cli/lib/check.mjs.reason: the manifest check of @polyspec/hyper-client and the template rules of hyper (HY-2, HY-48.3); no ecosystem tool states the rules of this protocol

packages/cli/lib/options.mjs.tool: parseArgs of node:util reads the options, and node:path checks that each input path lies inside the application

packages/cli/lib/program.mjs.tool: @polyspec/template-compiler compiles the templates into the PHP program and the type manifest

packages/cli/lib/shell.mjs.reason: the static shell of client rendering with the meta elements of HY-62, HY-125 and HYC-16; no ecosystem tool writes the shell of this protocol

packages/cli/lib/output-files.mjs.tool: node:fs writes and copies the files, and sets the modes 0644 and 0755 that HR-68 requires whatever the umask

packages/cli/lib/publish.mjs.tool: node:fs rename(2) moves each staged file into its target (HR-82)

packages/cli/lib/template-files.mjs.tool: node:crypto hashes the template files and @polyspec/template parses them

packages/cli/lib/template-rules.mjs.reason: the template rules of hyper (HC-6, HY-3, HY-30, HY-75) over the AST that @polyspec/template parses; no ecosystem tool states the rules of this protocol

scripts/board-servers.mts.tool: node:child_process starts the servers of a run and node:fs and node:os give each run its temporary directory (HR-87, HR-89)

scripts/build-templates.mts.tool: @polyspec/template parses the templates, through writeTemplateFiles of packages/cli/lib/template-files.mjs

scripts/check-bundle-size.mts.tool: node:zlib measures the gzip and brotli sizes against the limits of config/bundle-size.json

scripts/check-parity.mts.reason: proves that the browser code and the PHP, Node and Python servers render the same bytes for the requests of one file (HY-12, HY-13, HR-55); no ecosystem tool compares the renderings of this protocol; esbuild bundles the browser code and @polyspec/template renders

scripts/check-templates.mts.reason: the template rules of hyper (HC-6, HY-3, HY-30, HY-75) in packages/cli/lib/template-rules.mjs; @polyspec/template parses the templates

scripts/contract-programs.mts.reason: it writes the applications of the contract files with the server build of this repository (hyper-build-server); no ecosystem tool writes them

scripts/fixture-program.mts.reason: it writes the program of a test fixture with its fixed build id through the assembly of the command tool (HY-125.21); no ecosystem tool writes it

scripts/install-redis.mts.tool: the make of the Redis release archive, checked by its sha256, and PIE build the Redis server and phpredis

scripts/json.mts.reason: polyspec's rule that code reads a JSON value with what it expects and a failure that names its place, instead of asserting the type away (K157)

scripts/line-end.mts.reason: HR-84: a log line never joins the next line; the script ends each stream of a command that left no final newline, which no ecosystem tool does

scripts/pie-binary.mts.tool: node:fs reads the installed.json that PIE and Composer write for the package polyspec/template-php-ext, and its pie-built-binary entries (H27.51)

scripts/publish.mts.tool: node:fs renames, through publish of packages/cli/lib/publish.mjs (HR-82)

scripts/recipe/PhpScope.php.tool: token_get_all of PHP gives the tokens from which this class reads one scope of the PHP server (HYR-5, HYR-8)

scripts/recipe/barrels.mts.reason: a part of the recipe check of docs/spec/recipe.md (HYR-7, HYR-8, HYR-10), which compares the development spec with the readers' output and the case results; no ecosystem tool performs this comparison

scripts/recipe/candidate.mts.reason: a part of the recipe check of docs/spec/recipe.md (HYR-7, HYR-8, HYR-10), which compares the development spec with the readers' output and the case results; no ecosystem tool performs this comparison

scripts/recipe/read-node-scopes.mts.tool: the TypeScript compiler API of the pinned TypeScript 6.0.3 reads the scopes, the calls and the written classes of the receivers of the Node server (HYR-5, HYR-8)

scripts/recipe/read-node.mts.tool: the TypeScript compiler API of the pinned TypeScript 6.0.3 reads the declarations, modifiers, exports and JSDoc tags (HYR-8)

scripts/recipe/read-php-functions.php.tool: PHP Reflection and token_get_all read the functions and the methods that a class declares itself in the PHP server (HYR-8)

scripts/recipe/read-php-scopes.php.tool: token_get_all of PHP reads the scopes, the calls and the written classes of the receivers of the PHP server (HYR-5, HYR-8)

scripts/recipe/read-php.php.tool: PHP Reflection reads the classes, members, doc comments and constants of the autoloaded server package (HYR-8)

scripts/recipe/read_python.py.tool: the ast module of Python reads the definitions, classes, type statements, annotations, assignments and imports (HYR-8)

scripts/recipe/read_python_scopes.py.tool: the ast module of Python reads the scopes, the calls and the written classes of the receivers of the Python server (HYR-5, HYR-8)

scripts/serve-demo.mts.reason: the interactive demo of the board example in both rendering modes on fixed ports, held by the holder-lock of @polyspec/kit so that it exists once; no ecosystem tool starts the servers of this repository

scripts/serve-edge.mts.reason: the local counterpart of the CDN in front of the client-side rendering deployment: the API prefix goes to the API origin, /compare returns the comparison page, a file of the deployment is returned and every other path returns index.html; it runs on node:http

scripts/spec-docs.mts.reason: H2: the protocol documents are rendered from contracts/protocol.json by this script and checked against that rendering; no tool of an ecosystem writes them

scripts/tracked-files.mts.tool: git ls-files lists the tracked files of a path; the copy keeps their modification time and executable bits through packages/cli/lib/output-files.mjs
